decision: Keep external prototype only. Local copy reduction is real on fixed slices, but ~1.5-1.9ms absolute does not establish meaningful end-to-end benefit; prioritize existing bounded host overlap qualification and phase-resolved sampling/validation/pinning evidence.
limitations: Only first256rows of4 then8 real D overlay/base shard pairs were loaded directly from read-only Zarr. Full shard receipt/content requalification was not performed.
Exact keys/dtypes/values matched sliced baseline; prototype has no general mixed-schema, defaults, metadata conflict or invalid-index contract.
Repeated fixed512-row gather excludes actual epoch choice, decoder/refill, target preparation, CPU pinning, H2D and optimizer.
mode=clip is safe only for preregistered nonnegative in-bounds prototype indices; it is not a production-ready general gather implementation.
No GPU calls, active changes, full epoch construction or repository code patch.
